lines: Fisher manages $386B in assets under management as of December 2025 (SEC Form ADV, T1, current), serving 195,000 clients worldwide through 6,300 employees across 16 offices in 8 countries (Fisher Corporate Website, T5, current). The five-year CAGR of 19.4% reflects accelerating growth, driven by organic acquisition and market appreciation. The Advent/ADIA transaction at $12.75B enterprise value (Advent Press Release, T2, current) implies a valuation multiple of approximately 3.3% of AUM — a premium for a private RIA.

firmographics.narrative_md: Fisher Investments is the largest independent fee-only RIA in the US with $386B AUM and 19.4% five-year CAGR (SEC Form ADV, T1, current; Citywire, T3, current). Despite this scale, the firm’s client experience remains anchored in a human-led model: no proprietary client portal, manual onboarding, and a content-only mobile app (Fisher Website, T5, current; App Store, T5, current). The Jan 2025 Advent/ADIA minority stake at $12.75B valuation, earmarked for “global growth and technology capabilities,” creates an 18–24 month transformation window (Advent Press, T2, current). Salesforce FSC and SFMC are already deployed — positioning Zennify for optimization and expansion rather than greenfield implementation.
